title: Dev Container for AI Agents: Keep Your SSH Keys Safe
description:
Your AI agent doesn't need to live on your laptop. 📦

✅ Add a devcontainer.json with a base image
✅ Run as a normal user, not root
✅ Reopen in the container and see your SSH keys are not found

Day 9 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 10: Audit Agent Actions with Hook Logs.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #aiagents #devcontainer #docker #aicoding #cybersecurity #claudecode
comment: Dev container or sandbox: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: commit .devcontainer to your repo so your whole team gets the same safe setup.
